description: Revokes and removes one collector channel from a device. The input central removes only a channel of the same owner. This stops new authenticated input and removes the channel from the device list — also for a channel whose device was already deleted. It does not uninstall or stop the collector on the device (`uninstall.remove` in GET /api/ambientes/:id/inputs is the command for that), and stored measurements remain subject to their retention policy.

collector.description: alloy, telegraf, opentelemetry, ncpa, collectd or snmp.

id.description: Device environment UUID v4; the report URL is a one-hour write capability.

name: delete_device_input
title: Delete device input
